name: Otter.ai
description: Otter.ai is a powerful transcription service that leverages AI technology to convert spoken language into written text. It is widely used for transcribing meetings, lectures, interviews, and other audio content, providing users with accurate and searchable transcripts. Otter.ai is ideal for professionals, students, and anyone who needs to capture and organize spoken information efficiently.

events.d: Import an audio or video file to create a new conversation.
Retrieve conversations from the account. Optionally filter by channel or shared conversations, paginate results, and return only selected fields.
Retrieve the audio file or download link for a specific conversation.
Get your workspace's ID, name, owner, and member count.
